items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: in Basie's band you would call, all the colored chicks you'd call "Jane," and the black cats you would call "John Thomas."

ctx.x: Oh, beautiful. We used to just -- and Basie's band, too, had a name, too. We called -- if we played a dance and played a colored dance, in Basie's band you would call, all the colored chicks you'd call "Jane," and the black cats you would call "John Thomas."
